title: Compare Wine menu click and control at the same frame
platforms: Linux interpreter replay of Wine GUI recordings
changes: Compare the existing Wine action-menu click and no-click recordings at the same completed guest frame.
validation: Both recorded final states were reproduced at their respective 213/194 frame lengths; states matched through frame 132 and diverged on the recorded A input. Original recordings, copied ROM and state files were unchanged; build had no warnings.
limitations: Replay used recorded key masks and no frontend window events; exact X event frame and recognizer branch remain unobserved. At 194 frames guest clocks differ by two cycles. No patched build, partial reveal, USA or native Windows.
Managed cleanup rejects U31 units; evidence is retained.
